# Thallo Digital

> An AI visibility agency. Thallo makes brands the default citation and recommendation in conversational LLM search answers — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI and Claude.

The work is generative engine optimization: earning a brand a place inside the answer a language model assembles, rather than a rank in a list of links. Thallo publishes a free scan that measures this, and writes up engagements only from platform exports over a named period — an unpublished case study means an unpublished result, not a missing page.

Contact: hello@thallo.co

## Core pages

- [Home](https://thallodigital.com/): What AI visibility is, and why ranking first and being named are not the same thing.
- [About](https://thallodigital.com/about/): Why Thallo was built for a market that changed — what we believe, how an engagement runs, and who runs it.
- [Our Plans](https://thallodigital.com/services/): AI Visibility Audits, the Authority Engine and flagship projects.
- [Industries](https://thallodigital.com/industries/): How the work plays out in fintech, health tech, professional services and health & recovery.
- [Case Studies](https://thallodigital.com/results/): Engagements written up from platform exports over a named period.
- [Contact](https://thallodigital.com/contact/): How to reach Thallo.

## The visibility scan

A free scan that asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini the questions a brand's buyers ask, and counts how often the brand is named — with every question and every answer shown.

- [Run a scan](https://thallodigital.com/thallo-ai/scan/): The tool itself.
- [How the scan works](https://thallodigital.com/thallo-ai/method/): The questions, the models, the scoring weights, and what the scan cannot tell you.

## Case studies

- [From page two to page one](https://thallodigital.com/results/va-disability-claims/): A veteran-founded service in the VA disability claims space — +230% organic clicks over six months, from Search Console, January to July 2026.
